title: About Me
content:
Software Engineer Intern at INVENEO, specializing in accessible web systems and AI-integrated applications. Currently pursuing a diploma in Software Engineering at the Specialized Institute of Applied Technology NTIC, with a foundation in Mathematics and Physics.

Contributed to a humanitarian AI translation project during the Google DeepMind Hackathon, supporting data processing pipelines and ML-driven workflows.

Interested in scalable system design, AI agents, and building production-grade web applications that solve real-world problems.
